scope: Complete portable project with current Main pages, retained page history, checkpoints, local assets, notes, composition and evidence. Canonical generated exports are listed separately.
authoringBoundary: Mechanical inventory and packaging only; this manifest does not imply new authoring, model execution, installation or publication.

sourceSelection.scope: Existing regular files under this project, using tracked and non-ignored untracked paths.

sourceInventoryHashEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON of sourceFiles, keys sorted, no ASCII escaping, no trailing newline.
deliveryPolicy: Generated Exports files are excluded from the Git source tree and sourceFiles; complete project ZIPs include the canonical files in generatedDeliveries.
